## Orchestrator read-only triage (SSM/CloudWatch, 2026-08-29)

**Acute incident RESOLVED.** `rebar-gerrit-data-disk-high` is now **OK** (state updated 2026-08-29T13:35 PDT; datapoint 36% < 85% threshold). `df`: /var/gerrit = 50G, **18G used, 33G avail, 36%** (volume appears expanded from the ~pre-incident size).

**Root cause of the fill = investigation evidence dumped on the Gerrit DATA volume.** `du` breakdown of 17G used:
- `/var/gerrit/rebar-quiet-window-evidence/` = **11G** (65% of used). Two root-owned one-off probes: `epoch-probe-20260826T2200Z` (5.2G) + `epoch-probe-20260826T230602Z` (5.2G), created **Aug 26 22:00/23:06** — exactly the fill window (disk climbed 08-26 15:00→17:00). Each probe captured mcp/reviewbot/reviewbot-2/reviewbot-3 state. These are stale, one-shot investigation artifacts.
- `/var/gerrit/site/` (actual Gerrit data) = only **6.3G**. Largest: mcp-tickets pack 800M, reviewbot-tickets pack 730M (normal ticket mirrors).
- Leaked git temp pack `/var/gerrit/site/autolander-tickets/.git/objects/pack/tmp_pack_6XxddA` = 312M, dated **Jul 13** — a ~6-week-old leftover from an interrupted repack.

**Reclaimable now (needs operator approval — deletion on shared box):** ~11.3G by removing the stale `rebar-quiet-window-evidence/` dir + the Jul-13 leaked tmp pack. Would drop usage to ~7G/50G (~14%).

**Prevention:** evidence-capture (epoch-probe / quiet-window) wrote 5.2G/probe to the Gerrit data volume with no rotation/cleanup — same class as the AGENTS.md 'bound + clean up your artifacts' lesson. Recommend evidence capture target a bounded/rotated scratch location OFF the Gerrit data volume, with auto-cleanup.

Recommend: downgrade P1→P3 (acute over), do the approved cleanup, and file a prevention follow-up for the evidence-capture location.
